title: The client docs describe an app's card by labels only
body:
`src/content/docs/en/configure-apps.mdx:316-321` and the French page. "Logo, name and description" says a repository
sets the card with a logo file and three `vps.homepage.*` labels; Catena reads the card from the folder's `app.json` first
(names, summary, logo notice) and falls back to the labels field by field.

- **Behaviour:** the page says what `app.json` holds for the card, that it wins over the labels, and that the labels stay
  a fallback.
- **Security notes:** none.
- **Acceptance:** `npm run check`; the page matches Catena's card reader.

Moved from catenahq/ops#137.

title: The Restore docs may describe one long page
body:
`src/content/docs/en/configuration/restore-and-migrate.md` and its French twin. The Restore page now shows one section at
a time with an "On this page" index.

- **Behaviour:** the text names the sections as the page shows them.
- **Security notes:** none.
- **Acceptance:** `npm run check` and `npm run build`; a read of both pages against the page.

Moved from catenahq/ops#171.

title: Other pages name the application's old card after the page of its own
body:
`src/content/docs/en` and `fr` (`configuration/updates.md`, `configure-apps.mdx`). The application's page replaced the old
Apps card. Other places that say "card" for it may remain (status-page cards are another thing and stay); check that no
other page names it.

- **Behaviour:** every page that points at the application's old card points at its page.
- **Security notes:** none.
- **Acceptance:** `npm run check` and `npm run build`; a read of each page that names an Apps card.

Moved from catenahq/ops#185.

title: starlight-image-zoom plugin, once the docs have screenshots
body:
`starlight-image-zoom` gives docs readers a click-to-zoom modal on every image. Pointless until product screenshots land
(`public/` has no images yet). Re-evaluate when they ship.

Moved from catenahq/ops#283.

title: The client docs do not say how to move mail to a new domain
body:
A primary-domain change leaves mail on its own name, certificate and DNS records; the docs say "until you move it"
without the steps.

- **Behaviour:** a docs page gives the steps (the mail app's hostname, its DNS records, the clients' server settings).
- **Security notes:** none.
- **Acceptance:** the page exists in EN and FR, linked from the domain page.

Moved from catenahq/ops#314.

title: The app check page documents a rule K10 the checker does not have
body:
`src/content/docs/en/configure-apps.mdx:370` and its French twin list K10 ("matches a catalog app under another name");
the app checker carries no K10.

- **Behaviour:** the page lists only the rules the checker reports.
- **Security notes:** none.
- **Acceptance:** `npm run check` passes.

Moved from catenahq/ops#359.

title: Docs: the monthly report downloads as a PDF
body:
The Monthly report panel gets a Download as PDF button. Once a Catena release ships it, the client docs follow.

`src/content/docs/en/features/admin-dashboard.md`, section "Monthly report (Catena Business)": replace "To keep a copy on
paper or as a PDF, use your browser's print command." with "**Download as PDF**, at the top of the page, saves the report
as a PDF file; each of its pages names who the server is licensed to. To print it on paper, use your browser's print
command."

`src/content/docs/fr/features/admin-dashboard.md`, section "Rapport mensuel (Catena Business)": replace "Pour en garder une
copie sur papier ou en PDF, utilisez la commande d'impression de votre navigateur." with "**Télécharger en PDF**, en haut
de la page, enregistre le rapport dans un fichier PDF dont chaque page nomme le titulaire de la licence du serveur. Pour
l'imprimer sur papier, utilisez la commande d'impression de votre navigateur."

- **Acceptance:** `npm run check` and `npm run build`, after the release that ships the button.

Moved from catenahq/ops#481.

title: A docs page for the app checker's rule codes
body:
The app checker refuses with rule codes X13 to X18 and no page of the docs lists them.

- **Behaviour:** a docs page lists each rule code the checker reports, what it refuses and how to fix the folder, in
  English and French.
- **Security notes:** none.
- **Acceptance:** the docs gate passes with the page.

Part of catenahq/ops#233 (A docs page for the app checker's rule codes), which tracks the change across repositories. Blocked by catenahq/catena-admin#225, the part before it in push order.

title: Docs: the notice for services pinned off automatic updates
body:
A service pinned with `vps.auto-update=off` shows, on Catena Pro, the version the patch policy allows and what the
scanner knows, on the administrator's Apps tile, and `/apps/pinned` confirms one move (the service's image moves, with
copies of its own volumes taken while it is paused; a rollback puts them back). The client docs do not describe that
notice.

- **Behaviour:** a page says what the notice shows and what the move does, in English and French.
- **Acceptance:** `npm run check` and `npm run build`.

Part of catenahq/ops#296 (Robustness: R2. Automatic CVE tracking and emergency-patch pipeline), which tracks the change across repositories. Blocked by catenahq/ops#517, the part before it in push order.

title: Hosted jobs run on a stated Ubuntu image
body:
GitHub moves `ubuntu-latest` to Ubuntu 26.04 between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-19. Every hosted job of this repository
moves with the label as the rollout reaches it.

- **Behaviour:** every workflow runs on a stated image: `runs-on: ubuntu-26.04` after one passing run, or
  `ubuntu-24.04` pinned.
- **Security notes:** none.
- **Acceptance:** one CI pass on `runs-on: ubuntu-26.04`, or the pin in place. Workflow changes need a person with the
  Workflows permission.

Part of catenahq/ops#323 (GitHub moves ubuntu-latest to Ubuntu 26.04 between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-19), which tracks the change across repositories. Blocked by catenahq/ops#519, the part before it in push order.

title: Docs: the backup cadence line names the 15-minute schedule
body:
A Pro server scheduled every 15 minutes runs a backup every 15 minutes, and each backup after the first uploads only
what changed. Publish it once the test bench proves it on a licensed host.

- **Behaviour:** the docs Cadence line says so, in English and French.
- **Acceptance:** `npm run check`.

Part of catenahq/ops#368 (Frequent backups: prove and publish), which tracks the change across repositories.

title: Docs: the vulnerabilities page names the fix of each of Catena's own vulnerabilities
body:
For a vulnerability in one of Catena's own services, the Vulnerabilities page names the update that fixes it: the nightly
update to a named version, a named Catena release with the update button, or no fix published yet.

- **Behaviour:** `src/content/docs/en/configuration/vulnerabilities.md` and the French page say the three sentences and
  the button, in the reader's words, no version numbers.
- **Acceptance:** `npm run build`, `check:unicode`, `check:versions`, `check:prose`.

Part of catenahq/ops#378 (Catena's own vulnerabilities name their fix), which tracks the change across repositories. Blocked by catenahq/ops#526, the part before it in push order.
